item.title: Nace AI Releases Drex for Search for AI Agents: 92.05% on BrowseComp-Plus With 12.6 Search Calls
item.description:
Nace AI has released Drex for Search, bringing its Drex decision models to document search for AI agents. Nace reports 92.05% on BrowseComp-Plus with 12.6 search calls, and fewer agent turns on OfficeQA Pro.

item.title: Tsinghua AI Open-Sources AKV, a Cache Engineering Server for LLM Agents on SGLang
item.description:
Tsinghua researchers released AKV, an SGLang-based serving system for cache engineering. LLM agents drop and reposition KV cache instead of summarizing history, cutting average cost 27.7% across 4 agent benchmarks.

The post Tsinghua AI Open-Sources AKV, a Cache Engineering Server for LLM Agents on SGLang appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Nanbeige Releases Nanbeige4.3-33B, a 33B Open Agentic Coding Model
item.description:
Nanbeige LLM Lab released Nanbeige4.3-33B, a 33B dense Apache 2.0 model with 512K context. It reports 80.9 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and will teach the upcoming Nanbeige4.3-3B.

The post Nanbeige Releases Nanbeige4.3-33B, a 33B Open Agentic Coding Model appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X, a 14B Open DNA Language Model that Brings DNA and Natural Language Together for the First Time
item.description:
Hugging Face released Carbon-X, an open 14.8B DNA language model built on Qwen3-14B. It reads raw DNA in chat, answers in English, and averages 66.7% across 5 DNA benchmarks under Apache 2.0.

The post Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X, a 14B Open DNA Language Model that Brings DNA and Natural Language Together for the First Time appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Researchers from Stanford and UC Berkeley Introduce TokenGate: Token-Gated Attention Makes Long-Context Prefill Up to 11.3x Faster
item.description:
Stanford and UC Berkeley researchers released TokenGate, a drop-in learned token pruning module for LLMs. It cuts long-context prefill time-to-first-token by 1.4x to 11.3x and peak memory by 1.5x to 3.4x without accuracy loss.

The post Researchers from Stanford and UC Berkeley Introduce TokenGate: Token-Gated Attention Makes Long-Context Prefill Up to 11.3x Faster appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Anthropic Launches OSS Scanner, a Free AI Vulnerability Scanner
item.description:

The Anthropic OSS Scanner runs the company’s strongest models, including Claude Mythos, against enrolled codebases. Reports go straight to maintainers without human review. item.title: Microsoft Open-Sources Agensh: A Multi-Agent Harness for 1,024 Agents
item.description:
Microsoft Research open-sourced Agensh, a multi-agent harness with no central orchestrator. Self-organizing workers share a Git repo, chat and a findings board, scaling from 1 to 1,024 agents on ProgramBench under a 6-hour budget.

item.title: Cognition Open-Sources an Agent Plugin that Helps Secure Systems against Recent Cybersecurity Threats
item.description:
Cognition released the Devin Vulnerability Fixes plugin, 3 MIT-licensed agent skills that inventory, patch and test PHP, Node.js and self-managed GitLab deployments hit by this week’s critical RCE flaws, then open 1 PR per repo.

item.title: Meet Anthropic’s sandbox-runtime: OS-Level Sandboxing for AI Agents, No Containers
item.description:
Anthropic sandbox-runtime (srt) is the open-source, OS-level sandbox behind Claude Code. It restricts file and network access for agents, MCP servers and CLI tools with Seatbelt on macOS and bubblewrap on Linux, no containers needed.
